title: Cazuela Wrap with Lardon and Jfestive
description: A twist on the classic Spanish omelette, with crispy lardon and spicy jfestive.
instructions: 1. Cook the lardon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
2. Remove the lardon from the pan and set aside.
3. Crack the eggs from the cazuela into a bowl and whisk.
4. Add the diced jfestive to the eggs and mix.
5. Add the cooked lardon back into the pan and pour in the egg mixture.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the eggs start to set.
7. Add diced bacon to the pan and mix.
8. Use a spatula to gently fold the omelette in half.
10. Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
11. Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the omelette onto each wrap.
